name: Path of Death and the Soul

pages.name: Path of Death and the Soul

text.content:
Virtues: Conviction and Self-Control

Followers (Necronomists) study the part of the self that survives after vital processes stop, seeking spiritual mastery and freedom from both mortal and vampiric limits. They believe the soul concentrates in the heart after Embrace, which is why a stake can destroy a vampire, and they experiment to understand and overcome that vulnerability.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Failing to study how and why death releases the soul
  2. Fearing Final Death rather than trusting the soul's immortality
  3. Failing to discover a soul's unique composition through its behavior, or to pierce veils of myth and ignorance

Typical followers: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.nyOuQ8xvZEiNEJbM]{Tzimisce}, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.ZJx9H3XnU8yQGy9s]{Malkavian} and @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.clans.JournalEntry.GaCuLGcjZZjf2EO6]{Toreador} antitribu, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.antitribu.JournalEntry.pwzvpEssMLxrFaOG]{Harbingers of Skulls}; favors Necromancy, Thaumaturgy, Auspex, Vicissitude, Fortitude.
